description: assetGroup renames for consumers that key data on assetGroup (price / yield history). Each batch maps an OLD group string to its NEW one; every old string folded completely — no row of the lists carries it any more, and every row that carried it now carries the same new group. Apply a batch after publishing the lists it belongs to.

batches.summary: Liquity BOLD generations. `Liquity BOLD::BOLD` held the RETIRED Jan-2025 BOLD (Ethereum 0xb01d… + its CCIP mirrors 0x087c…), which moves to `Liquity BOLD v1 (superseded)::BOLD`; the live May-2025 BOLD (Ethereum 0x6440…b01d, mirrors 0x0356…b01d, Sonic 0xf05a…) takes `Liquity BOLD::BOLD`. ORDER MATTERS: move the v1 rows (by address) out of `Liquity BOLD::BOLD` BEFORE applying the folds, or v1 history merges into the live group. Scroll 0x0356… is a new row (no history).
